test_title: PYST 118: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 17 Jan, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three Statements are given followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All bottles are cups.

All cups are plates.

Some plates are tables.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some cups are bottles.

II. Some plates are cups.

III. Some tables are plates.

options.text: Both conclusions II and III follow.
Both conclusions I and II follow.
Both conclusions I and III follow.

solution:
Statements:

All bottles are cups.

All cups are plates.

Some plates are tables.

The Venn diagram as per the given statements:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36d02cde0f718e7bd6068888d25b6a6531eeda6bf3b15d1a027b4b24f526ff32.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some cups are bottles. → **follow** (All bottles are cups, which means some cups are bottles is definitely true)

II. Some plates are cups. → **follow** (All bottles are cups and All cups are plates, which means some plates are cups is definitely true)

III. Some tables are plates. →** follow** (Some plates are tables means some tables are plates is definitely true)

Hence, the correct answer is** "All conclusions follow".**
